ENGLISH ACTIVITIES — TERMLY EXAM #15
====

GRADE: Grade 1
SUBJECT: ENGLISH ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising Word Reading, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Word Reading.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Word Reading.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Word Reading.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Word Reading.

2. When practising Language School, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Language School.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Language School.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Language School.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Language School.

3. When practising Phonics, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Phonics.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Phonics.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Phonics.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Phonics.

4. When practising Pre-Writing, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Pre-Writing.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Pre-Writing.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Pre-Writing.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Pre-Writing.

5. Which word is a verb? (1 mark)
   A. blue
   B. run
   C. quickly
   D. happiness

6. When practising Language Welcome and, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Language Welcome and.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Language Welcome and.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Language Welcome and.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Language Welcome and.

7. Choose the correctly punctuated sentence. (1 mark)
   A. where is the library
   B. Where is the library
   C. Where is the library?
   D. Where is the Library

8. When practising Pre Reading, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Pre Reading.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Pre Reading.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Pre Reading.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Pre Reading.

9. When practising Comprehension, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Comprehension.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Comprehension.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Comprehension.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Comprehension.

10. A noun is a word that names: (1 mark)
   A. A person, place, thing, or idea
   B. Only a joining word
   C. Only an action
   D. Only a describing word

11. When practising Handwriting, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Handwriting.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Handwriting.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Handwriting.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Handwriting.

12. When practising Connected text and fluency, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Connected text and fluency.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Connected text and fluency.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Connected text and fluency.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Connected text and fluency.

13. A paragraph should usually have: (1 mark)
   A. One main idea with supporting sentences
   B. Many unrelated topics with no link
   C. No full stops
   D. Only one word repeated

14. The past tense of “go” is: (1 mark)
   A. going
   B. goes
   C. went
   D. goed

15. When practising Attentive listening, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Attentive listening.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Attentive listening.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Attentive listening.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Attentive listening.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. In three clear sentences, explain Guided Writing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

17. In three clear sentences, explain Attentive listening and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Language Welcome and and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Language School and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Pre Reading and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Phonics and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
